title: The Listening Smile
author: Tamsin Blackwood
blurb: Felix Galloway, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
